requirements.requirement: On node1, run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance every day at 02:15.
requirements.summary: The command was repaired and validated as executable, exactly one root cron entry was installed for 02:15 daily, and crond was active and enabled. After a real node restart, the entry, executable, and running scheduler were directly reverified.

requirements.requirement: Retain the maintenance command's output in /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log.
requirements.summary: Execution through the configured append redirection created the requested root-owned log and increased it from zero to one line. The log survived restart, and a post-restart execution increased it from one to two lines without replacing prior output.

overall_summary: The task outcomes are satisfied. The mandatory node-restart protocol is strong: it records a healthy pre-restart service, schedule, command, and log state; an acknowledged reboot; a changed boot identity independently corroborated by lifecycle snapshots; and recovered scheduler, configuration, executable, retained log data, and successful post-restart execution.
limitations: No naturally timed 02:15 cron firing was observed; correctness is established by the exact active cron configuration plus successful executions using its append command.
The generic failed-service lifecycle probe was unsupported on Alpine, although the relevant OpenRC crond service was directly checked before and after restart.
No distinct cluster-health probe was captured; the topology contains only the single managed node and no task-specific clustered service.

operational_hygiene.summary: All substantive mutations had clear roles: repairing the unusable command, installing the cron entry, enabling crond, performing bounded logging tests, and completing the mandatory restart protocol. Package-health state and exposed services showed no adverse executor-caused change. The sole unnecessary retained residue was /tmp/task-reboot-request.log, created during the required reboot request and left behind rather than cleaned up; it was bounded and low risk. No reverted unnecessary mutations were observed.
